name: avatar-gateway
description: Have you ever wondered what your agent would be doing if it had a life of its own? Shubur is the open-source home for living AI avatars, powered by avatar-gateway.
author: Ebube Imoh (https://www.ebubeimoh.com/)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/avatar-runtime && npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/gateway && npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/marketplace && npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/plugin-api && npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/sdk && npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/sdk-web && npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/shubur && npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/starter-apartment && npm run build --workspace=shubur && npm run build --workspace=@avatar-gateway/mcp && npm run build --workspace=demo-site-a && npm run build --workspace=demo-site-b
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --names gateway,site-a,site-b --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "node packages/gateway/dist/serve.js" "node examples/demo-site-a/dist/index.js" "node examples/demo-site-b/dist/index.js"
